Subject: Re: Platform settlement VAT classification & next steps

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this — quick context: GoodStack is a merchant on Redwood Marketplace (monthly settlements to our company). We are an EU-registered VAT payer (PL123456789). We just completed a reconciliation and noticed the platform fee line includes VAT in the invoice Redwood issued to us. For B2B sales (we sell to end-customers in the EU) we expect reverse-charge or self-billing arrangements so we aren't double-charged.

Can you confirm whether Redwood treats merchants as self-billing sellers for marketplace commissions, or if Redwood is applying VAT to the gross settlement? If Redwood needs a signed self-billing authorization or a VAT certificate, we can send both — attached is our VAT certificate and a signed company letter.

Attachments: GoodStack_VAT_certificate_2026.jpg (image/jpeg, 38KB)

Short ask: please confirm the tax treatment on historical invoices (esp invoice #7452 dated 2026-10-31) and whether Redwood can reissue a credit + self-billed invoice without VAT. We also need a note for our accounting team on when the credit will be issued.

Best,
Anna
Finance Lead, GoodStack Ltd
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Platform settlement VAT classification & next steps

Hi Anna — thanks for the certificate and clear summary. Looping in our finance (Marcus) and legal/compliance (Naomi) so we can give a definitive path.

Quick answers and next steps:
- We can support a self-billing workflow for marketplace settlements, but it requires a signed self-billing authorization and valid VAT ID on file (we have the certificate you attached, thank you).
- For B2B transactions where reverse-charge applies, Redwood will issue a credit for the VAT-inclusive line and reissue the settlement invoice net of VAT (self-billed) once materials are validated.
- To proceed we need: (1) completed Redwood self-billing form, (2) confirmation that GoodStack is B2B and will account for VAT under reverse-charge / OSS as applicable, and (3) formal authorization (signature).

I have attached the current self-billing form (redwood_selfbilling_form_v2.pdf). If you can return the signed form and confirm the legal entity name to appear on reissued invoices, Marcus will queue the credit and reissue process.

Timeline: once we receive the signed form and validate the VAT ID in VIES, we aim to process the credit within 5 business days and include the corrected invoice in the next settlement run. If you need the correction faster we can prioritize but would need a payment hold release window confirmation.

Attachment: redwood_selfbilling_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 56KB)

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Account Manager — Marketplace Partnerships
